title: Claude Reel 1 - I copied the experts. I sold nothing.
subtitle: Instagram version (comment PERFECT) · style: Halftone Dossier
hook: Here's how "being smart" by copying experts actually made me fail to make any sales for my offer (alternative: "Copying the experts is why my offer sold ZERO")
thumbText: But WHY? + mugshot polaroids of Alex Hormozi / Dan Koe / Codie Sanchez (black bar over eyes) + arrow to a circled 'Zero' + 'all copied. all borrowed.' (placeholder 3D faces until you drop real photos in _work/c1/thumb/experts/)
linkNote: Ends with: comment PERFECT and I'll send it to you (Instagram). Other platforms: asheraw.com/link, which has a tab linking to https://asheraw.com/blog/the-perfect-offer-doesnt-exist-until (other-platforms version not made yet).

checklist.t: Thumbnail is frame 0 of the video (2 frames), for platforms with no custom thumbnail upload
Starts with you in full view, then a swift push-down (at 0.7 s) into the lower window
Your cap/head pops out above the window border (cut-out of you, Kallaway style)
Hook text at the very top (unsafe zone) the whole video, 2 lines, one gold keyword
Colour grade A applied to you only (warmer skin, deeper blacks); the panel is untouched
Safe zones: captions and panel text sit inside x130-940 / y250-1436. Tick the 'show safe zones' box to check. The panel's gold frame edge is slightly wider (decorative)
Captions: 3 words max, sentence case, only the keyword in CAPS + gold; spelling follows what you said (script says 'believe', you said 'believed')
Length 68.6 s, under the 90 s Reel limit (speed 1.1x, dead air trimmed)
Loudness -14.4 LUFS; music 'Miami - Lofive' ducked under your voice; no marker/eraser sounds
Warm-up ('warm, warm, warm') and your two flubbed endings are cut out
Ending sentence is spliced: 'if you want the full article, more training and my prompts,' + 'comment PERFECT and I'll send it to you.' (from two takes). Please listen to check it sounds natural
Other-platforms version (asheraw.com/link ending): not made yet. Your take 'asheroll.com' was a mispronunciation, so that ending needs a splice or a re-record

Cut-out of you now uses Robust Video Matting (AI video matting, installed at D:\Work\RobustVideoMatting). The cap + head move as ONE piece with the push-down (no pop-in), and background no longer leaks back in
Images are 3D emoji (Microsoft Fluent) + Lottie animations, not flat shapes. Library: D:\Work\Assets (3,145 3D images). Real photos of experts still needed for the thumbnail

why: Halftone Dossier (a retro case file) was picked from 9 styles because this story is an investigation: the offer is 'the evidence', every borrowed part gets an expert's name tag, and the verdict stamps (SOLD NOTHING, NOT ONE FROM ME) land like a ruling. Runner-ups: Whiteboard (safe, but I already used it twice and it looks 'drawn'), Game Show (too playful for a 'copying fails' lesson), News Package (cold, better for explainers than a personal confession). Say if you want one of those instead.
